Man Kills Family, Priests Over Rituals; Shot Dead by Police

A man in Uttar Pradesh killed his wife, two priests, and his young son following an argument over rituals intended to ward off evil spirits. The man was subsequently shot dead by police. Reports indicate he held his children hostage before the police intervention.
